svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 540 mm of 40 x 6 mm flat bar; it is trimmed after bending.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend 1: up 90 degrees, its outside face 236 mm from the start end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend 2: forward 90 degrees, so the top of the tab is 212 mm above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the underside of the run. Bend cold in a vice round a 12 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: former; trim the tab to 80 mm beyond the rise's outside face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Run: two 6.5 mm holes on the centre line, 20 and 60 mm from the start.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tab: an 8.5 mm pivot hole 25 mm, and a 6.5 mm hole 60 mm, beyond

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the holes after bending; the drawing gives finished positions.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the run lies flat on the cleat (two M6 bolts); the pod plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lies flat on the tab (M8 pivot bolt and an M6 bolt in the slot).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the tab is level when the run is level, within 1 degree.
